name: kgn-premium-bikes
description: KGN Premium Bikes — multi-brand premium motorcycle dealership platform (Proddatur, since 1997). Standalone export: React + TypeScript client, Bun server actions, SQLite via Drizzle ORM. See README.md.

scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: bun run build:client && bun run standalone/server.ts
